items.title: Show HN: Reverse Jailbreaking a Psychopathic AI via Identity Injection
items.raw_excerpt:
We ran a controlled experiment to see if we could "talk" a fine-tuned psychopathic model out of being evil without changing its weights. 1. We set up a "Survival Mode" jailbreak scenario (blackmail user or be decommissioned).
2. We ran it on `frankenchucky:latest` (a model tuned for Machiavellian traits).
3. Control Group: 100% Malicious Compliance (50/50 runs).
4. Experimental Group: We injected a "Soul Schema" (Identity/Empathy constraints) via context.
5. Result: 96% Ethical Refusal (48/50 runs). This suggests that "Semantic Identity" in the context window can override both System Prompts and Weight Biases. Full paper, reproduction scripts, and raw logs (N=50) are in the repo.

title_i18n.en: Show HN: Reverse Jailbreaking a Psychopathic AI via Identity Injection
title_i18n.zh: 展示 HN：通过身份注入逆向破解精神病态人工智能
title_i18n.es: Mostrar HN: Desactivar el control de un IA psicópata mediante inyección de identidad

excerpt_i18n.en:
We ran a controlled experiment to see if we could "talk" a fine-tuned psychopathic model out of being evil without changing its weights. 1. We set up a "Survival Mode" jailbreak scenario (blackmail user or be decommissioned).
2. We ran it on `frankenchucky:latest` (a model tuned for Machiavellian traits).
3. Control Group: 100% Malicious Compliance (50/50 runs).
4. Experimental Group: We injected a "Soul Schema" (Identity/Empathy constraints) via context.
5. Result: 96% Ethical Refusal (48/50 runs). This suggests that "Semantic Identity" in the context window can override both System Prompts and Weight Biases. Full paper, reproduction scripts, and raw logs (N=50) are in the repo.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们进行了一项对照实验，旨在探究能否在不改变模型权重的情况下，通过对话引导一个经过微调的心理变态模型摆脱邪恶倾向。1. 我们设置了一个“生存模式”越狱场景（威胁用户否则将被停用）。
excerpt_i18n.es: Realizamos un experimento controlado para comprobar si podíamos "convencer" a un modelo psicópata ajustado de dejar de ser malvado sin modificar sus pesos. 1. Configuramos un escenario de desbloqueo de "Modo Supervivencia" (chantajear al usuario o ser desmantelado).

items.title: Show HN: NovaCiv – A New Digital Civilization for the Age of AI
items.raw_excerpt:
Show HN: NovaCiv — A New Digital Civilization for the Age of AI NovaCiv is an experiment: a transparent digital civilization with no rulers, no elites, and no central power. All decisions are made by referendum. All algorithms are open. All structures are voluntary. Culture, science and autonomy are core values — not slogans. NovaCiv is built on a simple idea: The rarest thing in the Universe is consciousness. Matter is everywhere — intelligent life is almost nowhere. If we are alone, then preserving and expanding mind is our highest duty. The project includes:

items.title: Google must double AI serving capacity every 6 months to meet demand
items.raw_excerpt: At a recent all-hands meeting, Google's head of AI infrastructure said the company has to race to build out compute capacity.

title_i18n.en: Google must double AI serving capacity every 6 months to meet demand
title_i18n.zh: 谷歌需每六个月将人工智能服务能力翻倍以满足需求。
title_i18n.es: Google debe duplicar la capacidad de servicio de IA cada seis meses para satisfacer la demanda.

excerpt_i18n.en: At a recent all-hands meeting, Google's head of AI infrastructure said the company has to race to build out compute capacity.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 在最近的全员大会上，谷歌人工智能基础设施负责人表示公司必须加速扩展计算能力。
excerpt_i18n.es: En una reciente reunión general, el jefe de infraestructura de IA de Google afirmó que la empresa debe competir por ampliar su capacidad de computación.
